haikus.haiku:
Sunlit waves whisper
Children laugh, hands join, peace blooms
Soft stars glow calm earth
Happy #InternationalDayOfPeace from @ClamBakeSanta

Pecan crumbs fall bright
Sunset glaze on soft warm dough
Crackling scent fills air
Happy #NationalPecanCookieDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Sunrise paints bright gold
Pages turn, tales bloom anew
Fireworks spark wonder
#HappyBirthdayHGWells from @ClamBakeSanta

Midnight candles glow
Pages turn, stories stir, soft
Night birds hum softly
#HappyBirthdayStephenKing from @ClamBakeSanta
